title: N-0085 U6: Proposed listings steward worklist with bulk confirm, and a per-customer Coverage lens
acceptance_criteria: Feed proposals becomes Proposed listings: customer, product, page link, how found, what the page shows (title, EAN, price); Confirm selected takes corroborated rows only and lists skipped ones
Coverage lens (?tab=coverage): per customer reported, watched, awaiting steward, failing, not found, not searched, plus site state; drill to products; counts match SQL
A paused site shows a chip with reason and next try; nothing blocks
Tests green on touched areas, tsc exit 0, eslint clean on changed files
